svg.title: The distance matrix after each round of k; yellow cells changed in that round: after k = A: B to D 15, C to B 8, D to B 5; after k = B: A to C 5, D to C 7; after k = C: A to D 6, B to A 7, B to D 3; after k = D: B to A 5, C to A 3, C to B 6.
svg.text: Yellow: improved this round. Grey: the row and column of k.
